learning_outcomes.text: Possesses current knowledge, software, theoretical and practical information in the field of Physics. Has sufficient knowledge to use physics-related resources.
Has theoretical knowledge about physics theories.
Can apply the theoretical knowledge acquired in the field of physics.
Can evaluate experimental data as required.
Can examine concepts and ideas in the field with scientific methods, interpret, evaluate and analyze data.
